payload.reason: The study discusses wave dynamics and mixing processes relevant to both nearshore and offshore environments, particularly focusing on wave-induced effects that can occur in various water depths and conditions.

claims.text: The study applies to offshore environments as it discusses wave-induced vertical mixing processes in offshore conditions.
The study also applies to nearshore environments since it considers transitional and shallow water wave cases relevant for surfzone dynamics.
The modelling framework can be modified to cover open-ocean conditions, indicating applicability to offshore environments.
The results may improve models applicable to ocean waves of random nature, which can include both nearshore and offshore conditions.
